exposure: Attendance at a prenatal childbirth preparation course (CPC)
Women who did not attend CPC
attending a prenatal childbirth preparation course (CPC)
cohort: 107 primiparous women (53 who attended a CPC and 54 who did not)
finding: Attending a prenatal childbirth preparation course was associated with lower anxiety levels, shorter labor duration, and higher rates of breastfeeding among primiparous women.
mod_finding: Women who attended a prenatal childbirth preparation course had a significantly shorter first stage and total labor duration, but no significant differences were found in mode of delivery.
